info.name: Inexo Backend API
info.description:
Complete API collection for the Inexo Backend.

Base URL: http://localhost:4000/api/v1

Authentication: Bearer Token (JWT) — Obtain via POST /auth/login

Default Admin Credentials:
- Email: admin@inexo.com
- Password: Admin@12345

request.description: Check if the backend server is running and healthy. Returns environment and database dialect info.

item.name: Auth

exec: console.log('Auth token saved to collection variable.');

request.description:
Authenticate an admin user and receive a JWT token. The token is automatically saved to the `authToken` collection variable for use in subsequent requests.

**Rate Limited**: 20 requests per 15 minutes.
Get the profile of the currently authenticated user. Requires a valid JWT token.
Get a list of all registered auth users. Requires Admin role.

Register a new admin user. Requires Admin role.

Fields:
- `name` (string, required, 2-150 chars)
- `email` (string, required, valid email)
- `phone` (string, required, 8-20 chars)
- `password` (string, required, 8-72 chars)
- `roleName` (string, required, 2-100 chars)
- `profileImage` (string, optional, valid URL)
Get a list of all available roles. Requires authentication.

Create a new role. Requires Admin role.

Fields:
- `roleName` (string, required, 2-100 chars)

item.description: Authentication & user management endpoints. Login to get a JWT token, manage users and roles.

request.description:
Submit a contact inquiry form. No authentication required.

The inquiry is saved to the database and an email notification is sent to the configured receiver.

**inquiryType values:**
- `sales` — routes email to SALES_RECEIVER_EMAIL
- `careers` — routes email to CAREERS_RECEIVER_EMAIL

Fields:
- `firstName` (string, required)
- `lastName` (string, required)
- `organizationName` (string)
- `inquiryType` (string: 'sales' or 'careers')
- `category`, `subCategory`, `product` (strings, optional)
- `preferredDate`, `preferredTime` (strings, optional)
- `mobileNumber` (string)
- `message` (string, optional)
